_comment: Your map's colors as plain VALUES — no code. Edit the hex strings; nothing else. This file is a pure edit surface a non-programmer can safely change. Import it in your profile .vue with a relative path: import colors from './src/colors/colors.json'. For color logic that varies per data value (e.g. color a pin by a field), use a code-based strategy .js file right here in src/colors/ instead — see this folder's README.
